release: Guardian OS V9.2.2 Floating Monitor V2
root_cause: The V9.2.1 floating-monitor CSS had been appended as literal backslash-n text instead of real line breaks, so the browser did not apply the intended fixed picture-in-picture styling reliably. The monitor therefore rendered like a large ordinary page element.
fixes: Replaced malformed floating-monitor CSS with valid real CSS rules.
Detached preview from document flow using fixed positioning and a 360px compact PiP size.
Added 16:9 contained video geometry so the stream cannot stretch page width.
Controls are integrated into the preview and appear on hover/focus.
Expand/minimise toggles between compact 360px and larger 560px PiP modes.
Added compact live state and risk badges over the preview.
Hide preview stops only the preview stream element; monitoring itself remains active.
Back-to-top button is positioned independently from the floating monitor.
Floating preview remains absent on the full Monitoring page.
performance_notes: The preview attaches only when monitoring is active and the current page is not Monitoring.
The preview stream source is removed when the preview is hidden or monitoring stops.
This patch does not create a second camera/MediaPipe/inference service; it consumes the existing camera stream endpoint.
